X.note: Clean but sterile CG. Walls are smooth flat colour, like an architectural viz or game level. Pavement is a uniform blue-grey with no texture. Ghostly semi-transparent figures in the foreground are a visible render bug. The crowd is a stiff mannequin cluster.

Y.note: Same geometry and crowd, but weathered plaster, peeling paint, stained stone, real cobbles and raking light give it a believable lived-in Mediterranean street. Walls are somewhat over-saturated orange. The identical mannequin crowd is the weak point: stiff, uniform poses, sitting on the ground without proper contact shadows. The ghost figures are gone.

why: Y's textured, weathered buildings and cobbles make the scene feel real, while X's flat untextured surfaces and transparent ghost figures look like an unfinished game level.
top_fix_for_weaker: Add weathering and texture to the plaster and pavement, as Y does. Remove the semi-transparent ghost figures. Then replace the mannequin crowd with varied poses and grounded contact shadows.
anachronisms_seen: Modern-looking clean railings and shutters in X
Uniform, generic crowd uniforms with unclear period accuracy
Tiny ship and flag are barely legible
